svg.title: Albury - Club Alex - whole upper-basement floorplan
svg.desc: Twenty rooms and supporting spaces. Guest club rooms west; operations east. Bar and games northwest, cinema southwest, wine suite south centre, screened mews arrival northeast. Diagrammatic guest and service connections. Approximate floor area 11,000 to 12,000 square feet. Schematic, not to scale.
svg.text: Private club, screened mews arrival and household operations
NORTH / REAR - UNDER THE TERRACE AND GARDEN
Bar defaults to stage up / 7 tables.
Other room sizes and door positions
Route lines show adjacency; widths and doors are schematic.
The documented floor area is approximate. Only the bar has a stated room footprint; no complete measured upper-basement plan is supplied.
Projection booth, staff overnight room and garden store are included. Stair/lift cores and corridors are supporting spaces, not additional guest rooms.
